finalText:
**Redis went down at 02:14:07 and never came back.**

`2026-07-04T02:14:07.113Z ERROR [api] redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`

Cache fell back to direct store reads. The store could not keep up. 173 timeouts followed, plus a cache miss storm. All 13 reconnect tries were refused. Queue depth passed its 500 max at 02:29:12. `worker-2` died of heap OOM at 02:31:44. Supervisor killed `api` at 02:31:52. Last good request was 02:14:03, at [logs/app.log:181](logs/app.log:181).

Next: find why `10.0.0.12:6379` refused every connection.
